players.product: 300mm silicon wafers (Zing Semiconductor), 300mm SOI wafers (Simgui) and MEMS/specialty wafers (Okmetic)

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: President Qiu Ciyun (results briefing): in 2026 the company will stabilise scale, secure shipments, optimise the mix and raise gross margin, releasing capacity in an orderly way and striving to keep revenue growing steadily with rising 300mm wafer sales volume, aiming for a marked improvement in results as early as possible. For 300mm heavily doped wafers it is validating with makers that use heavy-doped substrates, the Taiyuan base already has heavy-doped production capability, early validations went smoothly and some customers are expected to enter volume production this year. Executive vice president Li Wei said wafer prices are gradually stabilising and are expected to recover as demand improves, and that as domestic substitution speeds up, domestic wafer supply and demand will move toward balance, giving room to seek better prices.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 300mm wafer revenue about RMB 24.38 hundred million
